note.value: Brettonian sailing ships can move 9" during the Battle Phase whether the wind is astern or coming from the side. Only against the wind makes any difference.
note.value_en: Brettonian sailing ships can move 9" during the Battle Phase whether the wind is astern or coming from the side. Only against the wind makes any difference.

note.value: Some Brettonian ships are armed with Catapults. Catapults always aim high. A target hit by a Catapult may take damage in multiple locations as the projectile falls through the ship from above. If a location is damaged, also roll to see if the location below is damaged with a +1 saving throw (cumulative). If there is a choice between two locations, roll a die; 1-3 hits the left, 4-6 hits the right. If the location is already damaged, the projectile falls through and does not incur an additional +1 saving throw. In this way a catapult shot might fall all the way through a ship.
